name: @ahegyes/wordpress-plugins
description: DWS WordPress plugins monorepo — wp-env + Playwright tooling for cross-plugin work.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run wp-env:start
scripts.install:all: composer plugins:install && composer packages-install && npm install && npm run plugins:install
scripts.update:all: composer plugins:update && composer packages-update && npm update && npm run plugins:update
scripts.plugins:install: npm install --prefix=plugins/internal-comments && npm install --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce && npm install --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce
scripts.plugins:update: npm update --prefix=plugins/internal-comments && npm update --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce && npm update --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:internal-comments && npm run test:integration:linked-orders-for-woocommerce && npm run test:integration:locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce
scripts.plugins:test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --prefix=plugins/internal-comments && npm run test:e2e --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce && npm run test:e2e --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce
